title: no caption model is resident on max395 and a cold load cannot complete: the next post ships the placeholder
evidence: ollama /api/ps on 192.168.86.137 lists no model. Cold loads there do not finish inside Ollama's 300s llama-server start timeout (measured 2026-09-20: gemma3:4b 3.3GB failed twice and a third attempt was still loading at 4m42s; the 27B needs ~16.5GB off the same NFS store), so CaptionGeneration::ModelConfig walks its ladder to the fallback and then to the placeholder. Fix (max395): raise OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT in /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/override.conf, or preload the fallback model and pin it resident (keep_alive=-1).

notes.note: Filed by the new probe check added this run (bin/tc_ops.py): it measures CAPABILITY, not outcome. Live 2026-09-20 03:5xZ /api/ps on max395 = [] (nothing resident). Three cold-load attempts inside 16 min all failed: gemma3:4b (3.3 GB, the configured fallback) answered "timed out waiting for llama-server to start" at 301.4s (03:34Z) and again at 03:40Z, and a third was still loading when the client gave up at 4m42s (03:45Z). NFS read measured 51.5 MB/s on max395 (112 MB/s from this box), so the ~3.3 GB read is ~65s - the bulk of the 300s is llama-server init. Consequence: whenever no model is resident, ANY caption call fails and both producers substitute "Fresh look". Fix is max395-side, not in this repo: raise OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT in /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/override.conf, or preload gemma3:4b and pin it (keep_alive=-1). Auto-closes when any model is resident.

FIXED (repo-side) + the check that produced it was wrong. TWO root causes. (1) CHECK DESIGN: the check fired whenever /api/ps was empty, which is the NORMAL state -- Ollama unloads a model 300s after the last call -- so it warned permanently on a healthy path and could never clear. It asserted 'a cold load cannot complete' from a signal that never measured that. (2) REAL CAPTION-PATH FRAGILITY: the app never sent keep_alive, so every post more than 5 min after the previous one paid a cold load again -- the exact load that fails when max395 is degraded. CHANGES. bin/tc_ops.py: check_caption_path_cold now MEASURES capability by attempting a bounded warm-up (caption_warm(); budget TC_CAPTION_WARM_BUDGET, default 240s) and returns no issue on success; the attempt doubles as the repair because it loads the configured fallback and pins it resident. Added 'tc_ops.py warm-caption'. AI::OllamaClient takes keep_alive and sends it in /api/generate + /api/chat; CaptionGeneration::ModelConfig.resolve now carries keep_alive (CAPTION_KEEP_ALIVE, default 6h, 0 = Ollama default, -1 = pin forever) and both caption generators pass it, so a successful caption call keeps the model it used resident. VERIFIED LIVE: (a) healthy path -> check returns None in 0.0s with gemma3:4b resident; (b) forced-broken path (unloaded the model, pointed the warm-up at a nonexistent model) -> the check FIRES with the measured failure ('warm-up of definitely-not-a-model:1b failed after 0.0s: HTTPError 404'), so both branches are exercised, not just the green one; (c) 'warm-caption' cold-loaded gemma3:4b in 29.2s and pinned it (keep_alive=21600s), which also disproves the entry's own claim that a cold load cannot complete -- the 03:34-03:45Z failures were pre-reboot degradation (max395 rebooted cleanly 04:10Z), and the same load now takes ~30s against Ollama's ~300s wall. Specs: spec/services/caption_generation/model_config_spec.rb 16 examples 0 failures (5 new for keep_alive); tc_ops selftest 42 assertions 0 failures. REMAINING (human, out of repo): the durable hardening is on max395 -- raise OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT in /etc/systemd/system/ollama.service.d/override.conf (default 300s, which is why a slow load dies) and/or keep the fallback pinned. Not done here: it is another host's shared service and restarting Ollama would evict models other projects are holding.
